Large Data Path in COM: Only EventControlledTiming de- fined The ISignal is mapped into an ISignalIPdu . Only if this ISignalIPdu has an EventControlledTiming (via TransmissionModeTiming . eventCon- trolledTiming ) and Large Data Path in COM is enabled, this ISignal shall be handled by Large Data Path in COM.
